title: Photosynthesis basics (matches the gold / synthetic test set)

questions.model_answer: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants make their own food (glucose) from carbon dioxide and water, using light energy absorbed by chlorophyll. Oxygen is released as a by-product.

criteria.description: Definition: plants make food (glucose) from carbon dioxide and water using light energy

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: States that plants make food/glucose AND names light/sunlight, carbon dioxide and water as what is used.

levels.label: Partly complete
levels.descriptor: States that plants make food using light, but one or more of carbon dioxide, water or the product is missing or wrong.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: Blank, off-topic, or does not describe plants making food.

criteria.description: Names oxygen as the by-product that is released

levels.label: Stated
levels.descriptor: Says oxygen is released, given out or produced.

levels.label: Not stated
levels.descriptor: Oxygen is not mentioned, or a wrong gas is named as the product.

questions.prompt: Name the green pigment in leaves and say where it is found.
questions.model_answer: The green pigment is chlorophyll. It is found in the chloroplasts of leaf cells.

levels.label: Named
levels.descriptor: Names chlorophyll (a misspelling that is clearly chlorophyll counts).

levels.label: Not named
levels.descriptor: Chlorophyll is not named or a different substance is named.

criteria.description: Location: in the chloroplasts (of leaf cells)

levels.label: Located
levels.descriptor: Says it is found in chloroplasts (a misspelling that is clearly chloroplast counts).

levels.label: Not located
levels.descriptor: No location, or a wrong location such as the roots or the nucleus.

questions.model_answer: Water is a raw material for photosynthesis. It also carries dissolved minerals from the roots to the leaves and keeps the cells firm (turgid) so the plant stays upright.

criteria.description: Gives valid reasons: raw material for photosynthesis, transport of minerals/nutrients, keeping cells firm, cooling

levels.label: Two reasons
levels.descriptor: Gives two or more distinct valid reasons.

levels.label: No valid reason
levels.descriptor: Blank, or no valid reason is given.
